headline: Northern Vietnam leads in attracting FDI
summary: Northern Vietnam drew up to 80.5% of the country's newly registered manufacturing foreign direct investment capital in the first six months of the year. Its location and high-tech manufacturing ecosystem were cited as drivers.
why: Foreign direct investment in manufacturing shapes industrial output, export capacity and the growth of listed Vietnamese industrial park and manufacturing firms.
